🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 1, 2026

Moon, in Leo, holds a sextile to Uranus, in Gemini. Two tempers that rarely agree, briefly aligned: what you already own finally finds the words to be counted.

Easier — Agreeing on a figure without feeling robbed by it.
Harder — Agreeing to something because agreeing feels pleasant.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus have just closed a sextile, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon in Leo flows toward you — nothing resists, which is the risk. Cardinal fire: the opening move is the cheap one. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you from Libra, a sign it owns outright. Moon squares you from Leo, and the cost objects. Fixed earth: the grip costs more than the thing. Four weeks of Scorpio ended, and nothing carried over.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon in Leo opens a gap you have to step into. Air bends, and bending costs nothing here. A week ago Mercury was still held by Jupiter; that is finished.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you from Leo, where nothing is owed to it. Venus squares you from Libra: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Cardinal water meets a bill. The opposition of a week ago is off it now.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, is only passing through Scorpio. With Moon in your sign, nothing about worth stays abstract. Fire holds on until the thing and the self are one. The Libra chapter closed four weeks ago.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you and passes through Scorpio as a guest. From Scorpio, Sun hands you an opening. Earth adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. Mercury turned back two weeks ago; the review is still running.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you from its own Libra. Moon sextiles you from Leo: an opening to be reached for. Cardinal air: beginning costs almost nothing. The conjunction to Sun that held a week ago has let go.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon in Leo squares you: the price shows before the wish does. Fixed water: the grip is the expense. Four weeks, 15° of Mars: slight, and real.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, holds no rank in Leo and simply works. From Leo, Moon concedes the point early. Mutable fire: two answers, neither expensive. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. Sun in Scorpio makes room for you, and then waits. Cardinal earth opens the account without argument. The hold Mars had a week ago is not there any more.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon opposes you from Leo, and the account has two columns. Air that holds on, charged for holding. New since last week: none of it is habit yet.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Mercury trines you from Scorpio, and what you hold finds words unforced. Water that changes shape, and the shape fits. Seven days ago none of this was in place.
